subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: What should OpenClaw do when QuickStart selects Anthropic and the first-run model is an Opus-tier paid model?
rationale: The source path is clear, but changing defaults, adding billing preflight, or altering first-chat recovery copy affects setup policy and provider/model positioning.

options.title: Warn before terminal hatch
options.body: Keep the Anthropic default but require an explicit paid-credit/billing warning and recovery action before launching the first chat.

options.title: Change the Anthropic default
options.body: Move first-run Anthropic setup to a cheaper or more broadly available model, with upgrade guidance for Opus users.

options.title: Document current behavior
options.body: Keep Opus as intentional and improve docs/error copy, accepting that low-credit users may still fail at first chat.

recommendation.title: Warn before terminal hatch
recommendation.body: Keep the Anthropic default but require an explicit paid-credit/billing warning and recovery action before launching the first chat.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant Anthropic default and current wizard paths trace most directly to this area history.
